Citymaker.ContainerYard.Name: Container yard
Citymaker.Recipe.ContainerYard.Descripti: Shipping containers kept the way a real yard keeps them: stacks in long blocks, rows doors-to-aisle, truck aisles, an office and parking at the gate.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.style.Tooltip: What the yard is for. Each type has its own layout, not just different props.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.fill.Tooltip: How full the yard is. It fills from the main aisle outward, row by row, so a part-full yard still looks tidy.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.aisle.Tooltip: Width of the drive aisles between the blocks: wide enough for trucks and forklifts.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.office.Tooltip: The office row and the gate booth by the way in.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.parking.Tooltip: A row of parked cars on the other side of the way in.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.weighbridge.Tool: A concrete weighbridge across the way in, just inside the gate.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.edge.Tooltip: What lines the inside of the fence: a screen of trees, a wall of concrete blocks, a two-high wall of containers, a wall of scrap cars piled two and three high (back and sides only), a bund of big boulders bedded into the ground (open at the gates), or plain ground.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.fence.Tooltip: A security fence round the yard with a gap at the gate.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.ground.Tooltip: Concrete lays a slab over the yard. Gravel and dirt paint the ground itself: mud along the aisles, oily ground round the heaps and machines, dry grass along the fence. The aisles are always asphalt and whatever stands on the ground gets a concrete pad.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard to one pad, blended back to the ground at the outline. Permanent.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain: the yard ground, mud where the wheels go, oil-soaked ground round the heaps, worn dirt under the rows, dry grass at the fence. Permanent.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.spoil.Tooltip: Mounds of dirt in the corners no block fits, painted, with a dead tree and dead bushes on them. Raises real terrain. Permanent.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.banks.Tooltip: Long banks of earth along the back and side fence where there is room, spoil worked into their tops (rubble, boulders, now and then a heap of clay), stones and a dead bush at their foot. Raises real terrain. Permanent.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.stones.Tooltip: How many stones lie spilled round the heaps, the work pad and the banks, and along the dirt roads.
Citymaker.ContainerYard.rubble.Tooltip: Concrete, board and mixed rubble worked into the ground in drifting patches: only the tops show, like a yard that has been driven over for years. Never on the roads or a concrete yard; less in a yard laid out in blocks.
